name: Namaka
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the approximate radius Horizons carries for this satellite solution; these are not measured axes.
credit: JPL Horizons TNO satellite solution tnosat_v001b_20136108_jpl110_20221014: header radius RAD~ 85 km for Namaka
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the approximate 85 km radius in the header of JPL Horizons' satellite solution for Namaka. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no pole or rotation state is adopted.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed colour or terrain.
introduction: Namaka is a moon of Haumea, found in 2005. JPL's orbit for it rests on 29 observations from 2005 to 2008.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the roughly 85 km radius JPL lists. Shape, pole and rotation are not measured.
